dialogue.origin: こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: 12時から始めますね。
dialogue.content: We'll start at 12:00, okay?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: お時間になったので、はじめますね。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's time, so let's begin. Thank you for being here.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。本日のご相談ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor. Thank you for reaching out today.

dialogue.origin: 今日のご相談内容を教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 姑との関係で悩んでます
dialogue.content: I’m struggling with my relationship with my mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはお困りですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be troubling for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もう少し詳しくお話を聴きたいので、聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: I'd like to understand a bit more. Could you please tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: 話せるところからで構いませんよ。
dialogue.content: You can start with whatever you feel comfortable sharing.

dialogue.origin: 私への依存、監督、干渉がひどくて
dialogue.content: Her dependence on me, her supervision, and her interference are just too much.

dialogue.origin: 最近では家に居る事が多くなり
dialogue.content: Lately, she's been at home more often,

dialogue.origin: 困ってます
dialogue.content: and I’m having a hard time.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは、とても窮屈に感じますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must feel very suffocating.

dialogue.origin: はい、息が詰まります。
dialogue.content: Yes, it feels suffocating.

dialogue.origin: いつから、そのような状況になったのですか？
dialogue.content: How long has the situation been like this?

dialogue.origin: 詳しくは結婚前。主人と付き合って初めて顔を見せに行った時から、ぐいぐい入ってくる人だとは思ってました
dialogue.content: To be precise, it started before I was married. From the first time I went to meet her when I was dating my husband, I could tell she was a very pushy person.

dialogue.origin: もう２５年くらいになります
dialogue.content: It’s been about 25 years now.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。結構長いんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That’s quite a long time.

dialogue.origin: 差し支えなければ、あなた様の、性別とご年齢を教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: If you don't mind my asking, could you tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.origin: 女性、５０歳です
dialogue.content: I'm a woman, and I'm 50 years old.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、依存、監督、干渉はいつぐらいからはじまったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: And just to clarify, when did the dependence, supervision, and interference begin?

dialogue.origin: 結婚してからずっとです
dialogue.content: Ever since we got married.

dialogue.origin: 初めは
dialogue.content: At first,

dialogue.origin: 主人と２人で暮らしてたんですが
dialogue.content: my husband and I lived alone, but…

dialogue.origin: どうぞ、続けてください。
dialogue.content: Please, go on.

dialogue.origin: 無理やり家を建てる方向に持っていき、結婚二年ぐらいで同居に。それまでも電話は長いし、休みの日には来い来いと、用事もないのに呼びつけていました
dialogue.content: She forced us into building a house and moving in with her about two years after we were married. Even before that, her phone calls were long, and on our days off, she'd insist we come over even when there was nothing to do.

dialogue.origin: 逃げるのに必死でした
dialogue.content: I was desperate to get away.

dialogue.origin: 同居したら私の生活の時間を把握したくて
dialogue.content: Once we started living together, she wanted to keep track of my daily schedule,

dialogue.origin: カレンダーに書かされてました
dialogue.content: and she made me write it on a calendar.

dialogue.origin: 何時から何時まで仕事、休みの日はどこへ行く等
dialogue.content: What hours I worked, where I would go on my days off, and so on.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。逃げたくなるぐらい、しんどかったのですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see. It must have been so difficult that you felt like you had to escape...

dialogue.origin: カレンダーに予定を書かれていたのですか。そんなことされると、見張られている感じになりますね…
dialogue.content: She had you write your schedule on a calendar? That must have felt like you were being watched all the time...

dialogue.origin: 二階で静かにしてると、どうしたの？風邪ひいたの？ずっと家にいたけど・・とか
dialogue.content: If I was quiet upstairs, she'd ask, 'What's wrong? Do you have a cold? You've been home all day...' and things like that.

dialogue.origin: はい、服の格好に口出し
dialogue.content: Yes, and she would criticize what I wore,

dialogue.origin: 買い物の量に口出し
dialogue.content: criticize how much I bought when shopping,

dialogue.origin: ガソリンの無駄遣い、仕事の心配、ありとあらゆる全てにおいて、
dialogue.content: worry about me wasting gas, worry about my job... absolutely everything.

dialogue.origin: 子育ても凄かったです
dialogue.content: It was intense when it came to raising my child, too.

dialogue.origin: どうぞ、お話を聞かせてください。
dialogue.content: Please, tell me more.

dialogue.origin: 病院についてくるんです
dialogue.content: She would follow me to the hospital.

dialogue.origin: 被りましたね。すみません。
dialogue.content: I spoke over you. I’m sorry.

dialogue.origin: かわいそうに、こんな目にあわされて、とかママは新米だから我慢してねと赤ん坊のわが子を抱いて
dialogue.content: She'd hold my baby and say things like, 'You poor thing, having to go through this,' or 'Mommy is new at this, so you'll have to be patient with her.'

dialogue.origin: 私から離すようにしたり・・
dialogue.content: and she would try to keep the baby away from me...

dialogue.origin: うんうん。どうぞ、続けてください。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. Please, go on.

dialogue.origin: そんなこんなわが子も、大きくなって、今度は進路の口出し
dialogue.content: As my child grew up, she started meddling in their educational and career path.

dialogue.origin: ひ孫がみたい、、、その口出しが、もうしんどくて
dialogue.content: Saying she wants to see her great-grandchildren... that kind of meddling is just exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 孫だけじゃなくて、自分の息子が発した言葉も
dialogue.content: And it's not just about my child, but also about things her own son says.

dialogue.origin: 私に聞き直してきます
dialogue.content: She asks me to confirm them.

dialogue.origin: 息子、土日はどうしてる？なんで機嫌悪いの？怒ってたけどそうなん？とか
dialogue.content: Like, 'What does my son do on weekends? Why is he in a bad mood? He seemed angry, is that right?'

dialogue.origin: 今は食事の時間だけ一緒に関わる様にしてますが、たったその食事の時間すら、苦痛です
dialogue.content: Right now, I try to interact with her only at mealtimes, but even that brief time is painful.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。今の状況をお話していただき、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for sharing your current situation with me.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことを言われ続けるとしんどくなるし、また、本当に気持ちが滅入りますね…
dialogue.content: Hearing those things constantly must be exhausting, and it's truly disheartening...

dialogue.origin: すみません、矢継ぎ早に
dialogue.content: Sorry for rattling things off like that.

dialogue.origin: はい、滅入ります
dialogue.content: Yes, it is disheartening.

dialogue.origin: とんでもないですよね。
dialogue.content: Not at all.

dialogue.origin: 今は、主に、
dialogue.content: Right now, it's mainly...

dialogue.origin: はい、どうぞ。お話しを続けてください。
dialogue.content: Yes, please. Go on.

dialogue.origin: 自分がとにかく可哀そうで、の話を聴くのが嫌で、どうしようかと思ってます
dialogue.content: I really hate listening to her go on about how pitiful she is, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. I understand.

dialogue.origin: 何か調味料を出しわすれたら
dialogue.content: If she forgets to set out a condiment,

dialogue.origin: ほら、もう認知症が進んでる、どうしょう、と訴えてくるんです。
dialogue.content: she'll complain to me, 'See, my dementia is getting worse. What am I going to do?'

dialogue.origin: 毎回自分はもう駄目だ、こんな弱った老人なのに、誰も何もしてくれない。コロナに殺される。
dialogue.content: Every time, it's 'I'm useless now,' 'I'm such a weak old woman and nobody does anything for me,' 'COVID is going to kill me.'

dialogue.origin: と言わんばかりの言葉に、唖然です
dialogue.content: I'm just stunned by the things she says.

dialogue.origin: そうですか…それは、言葉がでないですよね…
dialogue.content: I see... That would leave you speechless...

dialogue.origin: 昔からそうですが、会話する度、こちらの気持ちが、よどんでくる？そんな感覚なんです。
dialogue.content: She's always been like this, but every time we talk, I feel like my spirits get clouded. That's the feeling I get.

dialogue.origin: 会話をするのが、臆になりますね。
dialogue.content: It must make you hesitant to talk to her.

dialogue.origin: はい、三日以上会話を続けると、お払いしたくなります
dialogue.content: Yes, if I have to talk with her for more than three days in a row, I feel like I need a spiritual cleansing.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。本当に、気持ちをすっきりさせたくなりますよね。
dialogue.content: I can understand that. You must really want to clear your head.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、義母さんは、認知症なんですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, does your mother-in-law actually have dementia?

dialogue.origin: 全く違います。忘れるのは私の方が多いです。しっかりされてます。
dialogue.content: Not at all. I'm the one who's more forgetful. She's very sharp.

dialogue.origin: すみません…失礼いたしました。
dialogue.content: My apologies—I didn’t mean to presume.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ。
dialogue.content: No, not at all.

dialogue.origin: 今までのお話をまとめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be all right if I summarize what you've told me so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなた様は、今義母さんと暮らしているが、義母さんから、行動に制限がかかりまた、いろいろな口出しをされて、息が詰まる思いや、気が滅入ることが日常的にある。
dialogue.content: So, you're currently living with your mother-in-law, and because of her, your actions are restricted, and she interferes in many things, causing you to feel suffocated and disheartened on a daily basis.

dialogue.origin: どうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does that sound right?

dialogue.origin: はい。そうです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.origin: ここでの一番のお悩みは、何でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you say is your biggest concern right now?

dialogue.origin: 今は主に、姑が頭の手術をしてから、医者は完治し、もうどうもないって言ってるのに、四六時中、自分が可哀そう発言してくる事、それも人のせいにしている事です
dialogue.content: Right now, my main issue is that ever since my mother-in-law had head surgery—even though the doctor says she's completely recovered and fine—she constantly makes comments about how pitiful she is, and she blames other people for it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: さきほど、おっしゃっていた、「自分がとにかく可哀そうで、の話を聴くのが嫌で、どうしようかと思ってます」ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is this related to what you mentioned earlier, that you're "having a hard time listening to her talk about how pitiful she is, and I don't know what to do"?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's it.

dialogue.origin: 一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.content: Let’s think this through together.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 早速考えていきたいのですが、どうしたら悲観的なお話を少しずつ軽減できそうですかね？
dialogue.content: I'd like to start thinking about it right away. What do you think might help reduce these pessimistic conversations, even just a little?

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいのでしょう。押したり引いたり色々してきましたが
dialogue.content: I don't know what to do. I've tried various approaches, pushing back and giving in.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。いろんなことを試されたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you've tried many different things.

dialogue.origin: 優しくしても、親身になっても
dialogue.content: Even if I'm kind or empathetic,

dialogue.origin: 結局は人の言葉は耳に入ってないみたいです
dialogue.content: in the end, it seems like what other people say doesn't get through to her.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。そのような対応をしても、今一つだったのですね…
dialogue.content: I see. So even with that approach, it hasn't been very effective...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 結局私の世話になりたくない
dialogue.content: In the end, she doesn’t want to be taken care of by me,

dialogue.origin: がベースにあるんです
dialogue.content: that's the underlying issue.

dialogue.origin: そうですか…
dialogue.content: I see…

dialogue.origin: 弱音を吐いたと思ったら
dialogue.content: Just when I think she’s showing weakness,

dialogue.origin: どうぞ、お話聞きますね。
dialogue.content: Go ahead, I’m listening.

dialogue.origin: 急にしっかりものの昔の指示ばかりしていた姑に戻る
dialogue.content: she suddenly reverts back to the bossy, commanding mother-in-law she used to be.

dialogue.origin: だから、適度な距離を保ってるんですが
dialogue.content: That's why I try to keep a reasonable distance,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 適度な距離を保ってもなかなかうまくいかないのですね…
dialogue.content: But it seems that even keeping a reasonable distance isn't working very well...

dialogue.origin: 食事の時間は、我慢だと思っているのですが、美味しくなくて・・
dialogue.content: I try to think of mealtimes as something to endure, but the food doesn't taste good...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。お食事の時間ぐらいは、楽しくお食事したいですよね。
dialogue.content: That's right. At the very least, you want to enjoy your meals.

dialogue.origin: 大変申し訳ありません。あなた様のお話をもっとお聞きしたいのですが、そろそろお時間になります…今日のご相談をしてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: I'm very sorry. I would love to hear more, but our time is almost up... How do you feel after our session today?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。こちらが話してばかりになってしまいました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. I ended up doing all the talking.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今は、いろいろな口出しをされて、息が詰まる思いや、気が滅入ることがありますが少しでも変化できるよに心から応援しています。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I know you're currently dealing with a lot of interference, feeling suffocated and disheartened, but I'm sincerely rooting for you to be able to make even a small change.

dialogue.origin: 心の中で姑の人格の整理らしきことが少し出来ました
dialogue.content: I feel like I was able to sort out my mother-in-law's personality a bit in my own mind.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: また、何かおこまりのことがありましたらご気軽にご相談下さい。本日のご相談ありがとうございますした。
dialogue.content: If anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to reach out. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （ロールプレイを終了します。貴重なお時間ありがとうございました。また、機会があればよろしくお願いします。本日は、ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (This concludes the role-play. Thank you for your valuable time. I hope we can do this again if the opportunity arises. Thank you for today.)

topic.sub: 姑との依存・干渉問題
